name: apple-contacts-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server for safely searching, editing, and maintaining Apple Contacts notes on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Safely search, edit, and note macOS Contacts locally.
interface.longDescription: Apple Contacts MCP exposes a local Model Context Protocol server for searching, creating, updating, deleting, and appending dated interaction notes to Apple Contacts through Contacts.app automation. Writes are dry-run by default and require explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Find a contact in Apple Contacts
Create a contact draft for review
Append an interaction note to a contact
